== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Blizzard 1 (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Blizzard 1]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Blizzard 1 (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only). Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
